name: kweli-bulk-place-agent
description: The bulk place generator — a Cloudflare Agent (FundiAgent, a SQLite-backed Durable Object), one instance per task, driving Overpass/Wikidata lookups, classification, and enrichment for region/country-scale place seeding. Independent of the Kweli MCP: exposes its own public POST /tasks, WorkOS M2M gated and org-restricted, so any Nyuchi/Mukoko app can trigger a bulk seed directly.
